activation_condition: the parent pilot is evaluable and primary_feasibility_pass is true
if_activation_condition_false: select no species; do not relax the 300-photo target or the 150-species requirement

primary_species_sample.eligibility: confirmed_at_least_300 == true in the fixed 500-species metadata pilot
primary_species_sample.selection: ascending frozen pilot_rank; take the first 150 eligible species

species_disjoint_split.assignment: within the selected 150, ascending SHA-256 of string 'train-eval|' plus decimal iNaturalist taxon ID; first 75 training, remaining 75 evaluation

pollination_guild.reason: no adequately global independently audited species-level guild frame is currently qualified; geographically restricted sources would confound guild with region

claim_ceiling: Outcome-blind species/sample split rule for later v2 design. It does not authorize acquisition or establish sharedness.
